device.description: Device file or image file of the partition (e.g., /dev/sda3 or /path/to/image.img)

backup_superblock.description: Block number of a backup superblock (for -b); 0 = use default

restore_files.description: List of file paths to restore via --restore-files (one per line in a temp file; extundelete will read it via --restore-files filename)

restore_inodes.description: List of inode numbers to restore (comma-separated in single --restore-inode invocation)

restore_directories.description: List of directory paths whose deleted files to restore (via --restore-directory)

restore_all.description: If true, restore all possible files (enables --restore-all)

before_timestamp.description: Only restore files deleted before this UNIX timestamp (for --before); 0 = unset

after_timestamp.description: Only restore files deleted after this UNIX timestamp (for --after); 0 = unset
